_comment: v1 multi-project example. Forge is project-agnostic — rename to appsettings.json (or merge into it) to enable. Each project is defined by a Git URL + (optional) deployment config; Forge clones the repo into <dataRoot>/projects/<id>/ on first boot. PAT for private repos comes from GITHUB_TOKEN env var or github.token in this file.

projects.name: Suikoden Launcher
projects._deploymentComment: Example DeploymentKind.Script: no build/publish/service bounce, just a one-line release action. ScriptPath is resolved relative to root when not absolute. The script receives FORGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT_ID / FORGE_DEPLOY_COMMIT_SHA / FORGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT_ROOT in its environment.

projects.name: Forge
projects._deploymentComment: Example DeploymentKind.SelfHostedSystemdService: the orchestrator building itself. systemd stops + restarts the unit after the symlink is repointed, so this is synchronous — no detached helper process needed (unlike the historical Windows Service path). See docs/deployment-pipeline.md.
